incident.summary: Preliminary draft concerning an unidentified multiversal signature tracked under the working name DOOM Protocol. The source, intent, and physical reach of the signature are not established.
observations: Sensors recorded a repeating pattern that does not match catalogued traffic.
No organization has claimed responsibility or requested coordination.
Analysts have not separated a genuine threat from a measurement error.
incident.conclusion: This file remains a draft. DOOM_LEVEL marks the classification of the subject, not an access role, and the record is not approved for release.
